title: Lithium industry east of Antofagasta
description: Much of the world's lithium is mined in Chile's Atacama Desert. Extraction and refining take place east of Antofagasta, so large smelters and plants are common there, as are big trucks carrying lithium on the roads towards Antofagasta.

title: Chilean altiplano
description: The Altiplano, the high plateau shared mainly by Bolivia, southern Peru and northern Argentina, also has a small Chilean portion in the far north-east. It is the only part of northern Chile with vegetation: flat plateau with golden grass tufts surrounded by mountains. It can be confused with the area between La Serena and Copiapó; distinguishing features are wide flat valleys, often with orange soil, and the grass tufts mixed with very dark bushes.

title: Los Ángeles street lamps
description: This lamp shape is a strong clue for Los Ángeles (Chile). It is identified by its flat underside plate, which looks offset from the lamp body above it; the offset varies but stays visible even in NMPZ.

title: Wind farms around Los Ángeles
description: Wind turbines in a landscape typical of south of Santiago point to the area around Los Ángeles, which has a large wind farm.

title: Striped car (La Serena and Concepción)
description: The striped car is rare in Chile and found in only two places: La Serena (Mediterranean landscape, orange soil, coastal feel) and Concepción (much more temperate, with 'middle-finger' pines). The two clusters are very distinct.
